req.title: Reject player creation with invalid id type
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when POST /players/ receives an id that is not an integer.
triggers: reject player creation with invalid id type

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject player creation requests with an invalid id type by returning an HTTP 422 status code. This ensures data integrity by enforcing type constraints on the id field. The test suite includes positive, negative, and boundary cases to validate this behavior.

tests.name: Positive Case - Valid Player Creation
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with valid player data.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a valid player payload.
expected: The response contains the created player's data.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

valid_player = {
    "firstName": "John",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "squadNumber": 27,
    "position": "Forward"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=valid_player)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["firstName"] == "John"
assert response.json()["lastName"] == "Doe"
assert response.json()["squadNumber"] == 27
assert response.json()["position"] == "Forward"

tests.name: Negative Case - Invalid ID Type
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with valid player data.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a player payload containing an invalid id type.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the validation failure.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

invalid_player = {
    "id": "invalid-uuid",
    "firstName": "Jane",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "squadNumber": 28,
    "position": "Midfielder"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=invalid_player)
assert response.status_code == 422
assert "Unprocessable Entity" in response.text

tests.name: Boundary Case - Maximum Length ID
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with valid player data.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a player payload containing an id at the maximum valid length.
expected: The response contains the created player's data.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

max_length_id_player = {
    "id": "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000",
    "firstName": "Max",
    "lastName": "Length",
    "squadNumber": 29,
    "position": "Defender"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=max_length_id_player)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["firstName"] == "Max"
assert response.json()["lastName"] == "Length"
assert response.json()["squadNumber"] == 29
assert response.json()["position"] == "Defender"
